“终于来京城了。”

出了京城国际机场，魏沐张开双臂呐喊，然后就被灌了一口沙子。

抹了把脸，嗯.....是熟悉的味道。

上辈子在京城打拼，一日三餐管饱。

早晨吃毛毛，中午吃沙子，晚上喝西北风。

今年因为奥运，比以前好很多。

来到约定的地方，等了没一会，一辆黑色的别克商务车停到他面前。

车窗黑漆漆看不见人，他打开了车门。

刚打开车门，一股暖风吹来，带着墨镜的秦兰坐在后排朝他招了招手。

“臭小子，赶紧上车。”

“我放一下行李。”

放好行李，魏沐上了车。

除了司机以外，副驾驶还坐着一个小姑娘。

秦兰介绍：“这是我助理苗苗。”

助理年纪不大，看着比他小几岁，小姑娘性格开朗，连着叫了他好几声魏哥。

“咳咳，苗苗，你以后就叫哥不用带着前面的姓。”

苗苗疑惑的眨了眨眼睛，轻轻点头:“好的。”

秦兰捂嘴调笑:“弟弟，有的人越缺少什么就越在意什么。”

“姐，那你误会了，我跟郭富成有的一拼。”

郭富成，什么玩意？

单纯的苗苗根本听不懂两人说什么。

秦兰却惊讶的低头看了看，眼神露出一丝讶异，小时候就那样，长大了能大到哪去？

江湖传言，娱乐圈有“四大雕王”，郭富成就是其中之一，这点香港狗仔记者可以作证。

魏沐觉得他也不差，打遍上戏无敌手。

迎着秦兰好奇的目光，魏沐嘴角上扬：“姐，你不信吗？”

“去你的，少拿你姐开涮。”

秦兰不是普通小姑娘，一般荤话奈何不了她。

她发这臭小子越来越不把她放在眼里，我这个姐姐没有威严嘛？

“我先送你去酒店，然后晚上再去见她们。”

秦兰给他安排的酒店距离市中心不远，从机场开过去大概用了三十分钟。

来到安排好的酒店，魏沐什么都不用管，拿着身份证登记入住。

收拾好行李，到楼下逛了一圈。

晚上八点，秦兰来酒店接他。

"Finally come to the capital."

After leaving the Beijing International Airport, Wei Mu opened his arms and shouted, and then he was given a mouthful of sand.

I wiped my face, and um... it smelled familiar.

In my previous life, I worked hard in the capital and had enough to eat three times a day.

Eat Maomao in the morning, sand at noon, and northwest wind in the evening.

This year is much better than before because of the Olympics.

After arriving at the appointed place, after waiting for a while, a black Buick commercial vehicle parked in front of him.

The car windows were dark and no one could be seen, so he opened the car door.

As soon as he opened the car door, a warm breeze blew in. Qin Lan, who was wearing sunglasses, was sitting in the back seat and waved to him.

"You brat, get in the car quickly."

"I'll put my luggage away."

After putting away his luggage, Wei Mu got into the car.

In addition to the driver, there was also a little girl sitting in the co-pilot.

Qin Lan introduced: "This is my assistant Miaomiao."

The assistant was young and looked a few years younger than him. The girl had a cheerful personality and called him Brother Wei several times.

"Ahem, Miaomiao, from now on you can call me brother without using the last name in front of me."

Miaomiao blinked doubtfully and nodded gently: "Okay."

Qin Lan covered his mouth and laughed: "Brother, the more some people lack something, the more they care about it."

"Sister, you misunderstood. I have a fight with Aaron Kwok."

Aaron Kwok, what the hell?

Simple Miaomiao couldn't understand what the two said.

Qin Lan looked down in surprise, with a hint of surprise in his eyes. He was like that when he was a child. How big can he be when he grows up?

There are rumors in the world that there are "four great kings" in the entertainment industry, and Aaron Kwok is one of them. Hong Kong paparazzi reporters can testify to this.

Wei Mu felt that he was not bad at all, he was invincible in every game.

Facing Qin Lan's curious gaze, Wei Mu raised the corners of his mouth: "Sister, don't you believe it?"

"Fuck you, stop making fun of your sister."

Qin Lan is not an ordinary little girl, and ordinary naughty words cannot do anything to her.

She felt that this brat was paying less and less attention to her. Didn’t I, a sister, have dignity?

"I'll take you to the hotel first, and then meet them in the evening."

The hotel Qin Lan arranged for him was not far from the city center, and it took about thirty minutes to drive there from the airport.

When he arrived at the arranged hotel, Wei Mu didn't need to worry about anything and checked in with his ID card.

I packed my luggage and went for a walk downstairs.

At eight o'clock in the evening, Qin Lan came to pick him up at the hotel.
